quotes.speaker: Landry Shamet
quotes.summary_phrase: Landry Shamet on Jalen Brunson's gravity and game-winning shot
quotes.excerpt: gravity of Jalen Brunson is undeniable, so he draws two, Mikal frees up and Josh last second
quotes.quote: They did a good job guarding it early, but again, gravity of Jalen Brunson is undeniable, so he draws two, Mikal frees up and Josh last second get close to a five second count. Has the throw to Mikal and Mikal's open, makes a tough play, makes a tough shot. We believe in him. I was in the corner watching, I saw leave his hand, I felt good about it.
quotes.social_post: Landry Shamet breaks down the final possession: The gravity of Jalen Brunson is undeniable, he draws two, Mikal frees up, and he makes a tough shot.

quotes.quote: That's just who he is.
